experiment: EXPLORATORY c^2-weighted Hessian pilot (novel modification of AGQ, not MoEQuant)
hessian: H_q = sum_i c_i^q x_i x_i^T, q in {0,1,2}; implemented as rows scaled by c^(q/2) (q=0: standard path)
c: fp32 softmax(router logits)[selected top-4], no renormalization (runs_agq_only_validation)
objective_note: c^2 is only the diagonal of the aggregated MoE output-error objective; cross-expert terms ignored
layer_selection: outcome-informed (AGQ L8 slightly worse, L16 -3.1 %); exploratory, NOT confirmatory

baselines.q0: must reproduce historical FR_s0 GPTQ weights bitwise for the 12 experts
baselines.q1: must reproduce the AGQ_FR_s0 weights (runs_agq_only_validation) bitwise

evaluation.heldout: ~/moe_cache rows 2128-2255, all routed tokens, frozen BF16 routing, fp32 math
evaluation.expert_metrics: E0/E1/E2 = sum c^j ||DeltaE||^2 / sum c^j ||E||^2 on the full routed expert MLP output; reported pooled over tokens of the 12 experts and as mean of per-expert ratios
evaluation.projection_metrics: sum c^j ||(W - W_q) x_p||^2 / sum c^j ||W x_p||^2 per projection, j in {0,1,2}
evaluation.subset_layer_output: A: all 60 experts historical q=0; B: 6 selected -> q=1; C: 6 selected -> q=2; error = sum ||y_BF16 - y||^2 / sum ||y_BF16||^2 (shared expert BF16 weights in y)
evaluation.decomposition: ||Delta y||^2 = D + C, D = sum_k c_k^2 ||DeltaE_k||^2, C = 2 sum_{a<b} c_a c_b <DeltaE_a, DeltaE_b>

cost.measured_as: Profiler Hessian pass + 36 GPTQ solves per layer

decision_rule.C2_PILOT_PROMISING: pooled E2(q2) <= -1 % vs q1 AND layer output (C vs B) improves in >= 1 of L8/L16 AND no layer regresses by > 0.5 % vs q1 AND correctness AND cost modest
decision_rule.C2_REGRESSION: any layer output (C vs B) > +0.5 %, or unstable quantization (non-finite / dead-column change)
decision_rule.C2_SURROGATE_ONLY: pooled E2 criterion met but layer-output criteria not
decision_rule.note: screening rules, not significance tests; frozen before any q = 2 quality result

limits: no extrapolation from subset to full layer
